cards.title: Connect your sound
cards.body: Select SP-1 as your computer or phone’s USB audio output, or pair it over Bluetooth. Both inputs can play together.
cards.note: The headphone jack is an output. Bluetooth audio input is separate from the companion’s Bluetooth control connection.

steps.label: Audio enters through USB-C
steps.detail: Select SP-1 as your host’s USB audio output. Bluetooth audio can be paired separately.

steps.label: Listen through headphones
steps.detail: Or use the built-in speaker.

cards.title: Wake. Power off.
cards.body: Hold FN about 1.5 seconds to wake. To power off, stop playback and hold FN about 2.5 seconds.
cards.note: USB power can keep the charging gauge active.

steps.label: Hold FN to wake
steps.detail: The side row fills during the 1.5-second hold. Track lights stay dark.

steps.label: Release FN
steps.detail: After release and startup, the side row fills briefly, then clears.

steps.label: To power off, stop playback first
steps.detail: Keep FN held: side lights fill over 2.5 seconds, then clear. Track lights stay dark.

steps.label: Release FN
steps.detail: The player is off. On battery, every light stays dark.

steps.label: While charging over USB
steps.detail: Example: three levels of charge. The last lit side LED blinks while charging.

cards.title: Make your first loop
cards.gesture: Arm → send sound → tap to finish
cards.body: Tap an empty track to arm it. Start your audio to begin recording. Tap the same track again to finish the loop, then raise its fader.
cards.note: While armed, tap PLAY to cancel and pause. Once recording starts, tap its track to finish.

steps.label: Tap T1 to arm it
steps.detail: Use an empty track for your first recording.

steps.label: Blinking means ready to record
steps.detail: T1 is armed and waiting for sound.

steps.label: Start your audio
steps.detail: Recording starts when input sound arrives. T1’s light turns solid.

steps.label: Tap T1 to finish
steps.detail: The new take becomes a loop.

steps.label: Raise fader 1
steps.detail: Bring the new track into your mix.

cards.title: Play. Stop. Restart.
cards.body: Tap PLAY to start or stop. Hold PLAY, then release to restart.

steps.label: Tap PLAY
steps.detail: Start or stop playback.

steps.label: Release
steps.detail: Start or stop playback.

steps.label: Hold PLAY for a restart
steps.detail: Keep PLAY held, then release to restart from the beginning.

steps.label: Release PLAY
steps.detail: Playback restarts.

cards.title: Mix four tracks
cards.body: Raise a fader to bring its track forward. Lower it to pull that track back.

steps.label: Find fader 1
steps.detail: Faders 1–4 always correspond to tracks 1–4 in the normal mix.

steps.label: Lower track 1
steps.detail: Lower F1 to turn track 1 down.

steps.label: Move back up
steps.detail: Raise F1 to bring track 1 back into the mix.

cards.title: Set the listening level
cards.body: Use the two round buttons on the top edge to change master volume.

steps.label: Press VOL+
steps.detail: Raise the output level.

steps.label: Release
steps.detail: The new listening level stays set.

steps.label: Press VOL−
steps.detail: Lower the output level.

steps.label: Release
steps.detail: The new listening level stays set.

cards.title: Mute. Restore.
cards.body: Tap a loaded track to mute it. Tap again to restore it.
cards.note: Several track buttons can toggle their mutes together. Muting keeps the recorded audio.

steps.label: Tap T1
steps.detail: Mute its loaded take.

steps.label: The muted track stays loaded
steps.detail: Its light becomes a dim ghost.

steps.label: Tap T1 again
steps.detail: Restore the track.

cards.title: Keep more than one take
cards.gesture: TRACK + ROCKER DOWN = saved takes · TRACK + ROCKER UP = New
cards.body: Hold a track and click ROCKER DOWN to cycle its recorded takes. ROCKER UP selects an empty New lane. Record normally there; your earlier takes stay saved. Each song and track has its own lane.
cards.note: Switch while playing or stopped. A New lane breathes when it has saved takes. Hold FN during playback to count the total takes on each track; the counts repeat together.

steps.label: Choose New
steps.detail: In normal track mode, hold T1 and click ROCKER UP. Your current take stays saved.

steps.label: Record another version
steps.detail: Release both controls, then tap T1 to arm the empty lane. Tap again to finish.

steps.label: Browse saved takes
steps.detail: Hold T1 and click ROCKER DOWN for each take. Switching follows the running song position.

steps.label: Preview the totals
steps.detail: During playback, hold FN. Each track LED counts its total saved takes, including when on New.

cards.title: Overdub the current take
cards.body: Hold a loaded track for 0.6 seconds to prepare overdub. Release, then tap it within 10 seconds to arm. Tap again to finish.
cards.note: The earlier take stays saved in this track’s lane. TRACK + ROCKER DOWN finds it after the new recording is saved. Tap FN to cancel preparation.

steps.label: Hold the loaded track
steps.detail: Hold for 0.6 seconds. This prepares overdub; it does not start recording.

steps.label: Release the track
steps.detail: The confirmation window lasts 10 seconds.

steps.label: Tap T1 to arm
steps.detail: Send sound, or wait for the grid punch-in.

steps.label: Tap T1 to finish
steps.detail: The new result is saved as another take; the earlier audio remains available.

cards.title: Delete a take
cards.body: Double-tap the track, holding the second press until deletion is acknowledged. This removes the selected take; other takes remain.
cards.note: If the track is still saving, wait for saving to finish and try again. TRACK + ROCKER DOWN finds the remaining takes.

steps.label: Double-tap T1; hold the second press
steps.detail: The track light goes dark when the take is deleted.

steps.label: The track is empty
steps.detail: Its light goes dark.

cards.title: Find a song
cards.body: Choose a bank with T1–T4. Repeat the same button to step through that bank’s four songs.
cards.note: Use this from normal track mode. A longer FN + track hold opens a page instead.

steps.label: Hold FN
steps.detail: Keep FN held.

steps.label: Tap T1 briefly
steps.detail: Select bank 1. Repeat to step through its four songs.

steps.label: Read the song lights
steps.detail: Solid identifies the bank; blinking identifies the song.

cards.title: Fixed or variable loops
cards.body: Briefly hold FN + PLAY, then release both to switch loop length mode.
cards.note: Fixed rounds each take to a whole multiple of the base loop, keeping tracks aligned. Variable preserves each recorded length, so tracks can cycle independently. The side lights confirm your choice.

steps.label: Hold FN + PLAY
steps.detail: Hold briefly, then release both to switch modes.

steps.label: Fixed: two flashes
steps.detail: All four side lights flash together twice.

steps.label: Repeat the same gesture
steps.detail: Hold FN + PLAY, then release both to switch back.

steps.label: Variable: out and back
steps.detail: The side lights run 1–2–3–4–3–2–1.

cards.title: Adjust LED brightness
cards.body: Keep FN + PLAY held through five seconds. The lights change while you hold.
cards.note: This longer hold leaves loop length mode unchanged.

steps.label: Keep FN + PLAY held
steps.detail: Wait through five seconds.

steps.label: Watch the light level change
steps.detail: The selected brightness is saved.

cards.title: Change speed & pitch
cards.body: Click for a speed step, double-click for a semitone, or hold to sweep. Pitch follows speed.
cards.note: Tape speed ranges from 0.25× to 2×.

steps.label: Click the rocker up
steps.detail: One speed step.

steps.label: Double-click
steps.detail: One semitone.

steps.label: Hold to sweep
steps.detail: Let go to stop changing speed.

steps.label: Release
steps.detail: The rocker returns to center.

cards.title: Return to 1×
cards.body: Hold FN and tap PLAY twice. The tape returns to its normal speed.
cards.note: Also restores rocker tape transformations, including Magnet and Scissors. Recordings and effect-page settings stay intact.

steps.label: Hold FN
steps.detail: Example starts at half speed. Keep it held for both taps.

steps.label: Double-tap PLAY
steps.detail: Return the tape to normal speed.

steps.label: Release
steps.detail: Playback returns to 1×.

cards.title: Jump an octave
cards.body: With FN and PLAY held, click down for an octave lower or up for an octave higher.
cards.note: A step outside the tape-speed range does nothing.

steps.label: Hold FN + PLAY
steps.detail: Keep both held.

steps.label: Press the rocker down briefly
steps.detail: 1× → 0.5×: one octave down.

steps.label: Press the rocker up briefly
steps.detail: 0.5× → 1×: back up one octave.

cards.title: Shorten the loop window
cards.body: Up halves the window. Down doubles it. Hold to keep stepping.
cards.note: The chop stays inside your fader-set region.

steps.label: Hold FN
steps.detail: Keep it held while using the rocker.

steps.label: Up halves
steps.detail: Click or hold.

steps.label: Down doubles
steps.detail: Click or hold.

steps.label: Release
steps.detail: Your chop remains.

cards.title: Move the window
cards.body: Step the chop earlier or later through your region.
cards.note: With a page open, this same chord walks pages instead.

steps.label: Hold FN
steps.detail: A quarter-loop chop is already playing. Keep FN held.

steps.label: Press VOL+
steps.detail: Move the chop later. VOL− moves it earlier.

cards.title: One window. Four faders.
cards.body: F1 = start. F2 = end. F3 = position. F4 = size / zoom.
cards.note: Edits start from the audible window. F4 down tightens; top restores the region set by F1–F3. Re-gripping FN preserves that region.

steps.label: Hold FN
steps.detail: Move deliberately to engage a window fader.

steps.label: F1: start · F2: end
steps.detail: Set the two edges.

steps.label: F3: position
steps.detail: Slide the region without changing its width.

steps.label: F4: size / zoom
steps.detail: Down tightens around the center.

steps.label: F4 back to the top
steps.detail: Restore the region set by F1–F3.

steps.label: Release FN
steps.detail: Cross the saved track level to resume volume control.

cards.title: Reverse the window
cards.body: Hold FN and move F1—the start—past the end set by F2 to reverse the window.
cards.note: Crossing edges during a beat repeat does not reverse it.

steps.label: Cross the edges
steps.detail: Move F1 beyond the end set by F2.

steps.label: Release
steps.detail: The window plays in reverse.

cards.title: Whole loop or home
cards.body: VOL− resets to the whole loop, forwards. VOL+ returns home while keeping chop size and direction.
cards.note: Use outside a repeat. Reset clears window reverse; per-track reverse stays. During repeat, the volume buttons move its window.

steps.label: Hold FN + PLAY
steps.detail: A reversed quarter-loop window is already playing. Keep FN + PLAY held.

steps.label: Press VOL−
steps.detail: Whole loop, forwards.

steps.label: Hold FN + PLAY
steps.detail: For this second example, a quarter-loop chop starts away from home.

steps.label: Press VOL+
steps.detail: Home, with chop size kept.

cards.title: Reverse one track
cards.body: Hold FN + the track button first, then tap PLAY before its page opens. Repeat to reverse back.
cards.note: Press order matters. FN + PLAY first, then the track, isolates instead.

steps.label: FN + T1, then PLAY
steps.detail: Tap PLAY promptly, before the page opens.

steps.label: Release
steps.detail: Repeat the gesture to reverse back.

cards.title: Momentarily isolate
cards.body: Hold FN + PLAY first. Then press the track you want to hear alone.
cards.note: Release the track to restore the previous mutes.

steps.label: Hold FN + PLAY first

steps.label: Add T1
steps.detail: Hear track 1 alone.

steps.label: Release T1

cards.title: Enter four-head mode
cards.body: Start with a loop playing in normal track mode. Hold FN and triple-tap PLAY. Repeat to exit.
cards.note: Faders set head levels, track taps mute, and FN + faders set head positions.

steps.label: Hold FN
steps.detail: Keep it held through three taps.

steps.label: Release

cards.gesture: FN + faders · hold a loaded track
cards.body: In heads mode, FN + faders positions the heads. Hold another loaded track to make it the source.

cards.title: Tap a beat grid
cards.body: From normal track mode, tap FN at least four times in time. Start on the downbeat.
cards.note: Fresh taps align recording to beats. The saved grid follows the loop; tape speed changes its tempo.

steps.label: Tap FN in time
steps.detail: Start on the downbeat; at least four taps.

steps.label: Follow the beat lights
steps.detail: Retap a loaded loop to match tempo.

cards.title: Clear the beat grid
cards.gesture: Tap FN → press again and hold · ~1 s
cards.body: Tap FN, then quickly press it again and hold about one second to clear the beat grid.
cards.note: The four TRACK lights briefly turn solid. Your recorded audio stays in place.

steps.label: Clear the grid
steps.detail: Tap, quickly press again, then hold about 1 second.

cards.title: Round to the nearest whole BPM
cards.gesture: Tap FN 4+ times → hold FN · ~1 s
cards.body: Tap FN at least four times in time, then press and hold FN about one second to round the tapped tempo to the nearest whole BPM. For example: 119.8 to 120 BPM.
cards.note: Sweep = rounding succeeded. Shrug = no rounding applied; the tempo stays unchanged.

steps.label: Tap a new tempo
steps.detail: Tap FN at least four times in time. This example rounds 119.8 to 120 BPM.

steps.label: Hold FN to round
steps.detail: After tapping, press and hold FN about one second to round to the nearest whole BPM.

steps.label: Sweep: rounding succeeded
steps.detail: The track lights sweep out and back: 119.8 BPM rounded to 120 BPM.

steps.label: If rounding is not applied
steps.detail: All four track lights blink together: the tempo stays unchanged.

cards.body: Hold FN with a track button. Release both after the page opens. The page stays open.

cards.body: Use PLAY + the destination track again to stop a bounce while a page is open.

steps.label: Hold PLAY
steps.detail: With Page 2 open and Track 2 recording the copy, keep PLAY held.

steps.label: Tap the destination
steps.detail: Stop the copy.

cards.title: Let the song flow back in
cards.gesture: After starting the copy, release PLAY
cards.body: The repeat ends and the tape copy continues from the running tape position. Tap the destination again to stop.

steps.label: Your repeat is being copied
steps.detail: Example destination: T2.

steps.label: Release PLAY
steps.detail: The song flows back in; the copy keeps recording.

steps.label: Tap T2 to finish
steps.detail: End the copy.

cards.title: Sweep speed into a take
cards.gesture: During a bounce: release PLAY → rocker
cards.body: Use the rocker while a tape copy or sampler print is recording. Your speed moves become part of the performance.
cards.note: Tape copy records speed moves relative to starting speed. Sampler print bakes the performance for playback at 1×.

steps.label: During a tape copy, leave PLAY released
steps.detail: Use the rocker for speed.

steps.label: Sweep the tape
steps.detail: Hold the rocker to change speed.

steps.label: Release the rocker
steps.detail: The copy continues.

cards.title: Perform inside a sampler print
cards.gesture: Keep the destination held · PLAY changes the rocker
cards.body: Keep the destination held. With PLAY released, the rocker changes speed. With PLAY held, it controls beat repeat. Add FN for octave jumps.
cards.note: Release the destination to end the print. Release PLAY too to end the repeat.

steps.label: Keep destination T2 held
steps.detail: This keeps the sampler print recording.

steps.label: Add FN for an octave
steps.detail: Down halves the tape speed; the repeat stays active.

steps.label: Release T2 and PLAY
steps.detail: End the print and repeat.

cards.title: Scissors / glue
cards.gesture: Slot 7 · ROCKER DOWN marks, ROCKER DOWN cuts · ROCKER UP undoes
cards.body: While playing, tap ROCKER DOWN at the start and again at the end of a section to skip it. With the rocker page open, hold the same TRACK for both marks to cut only that track. Bare ROCKER DOWN targets the loaded tracks.
cards.note: Make up to eight cuts. ROCKER UP cancels a pending mark or undoes the last cut. Cuts remain when leaving the rocker page or slot. FN + double-tap PLAY restores the tape. Cuts are non-destructive session edits; changing songs, takes, recording or rebooting clears them. Use full forward loops, without trim, Heads, repeat or recording.

steps.label: Open the rocker page
steps.detail: Hold FN and both volume buttons, then release.

steps.label: Select Scissors / glue
steps.detail: From Magnet in slot 6, press VOL+ to select slot 7.

steps.label: Mark the start on the full tape
steps.detail: With playback running, tap ROCKER DOWN. The mark applies to all loaded tracks.

steps.label: Make the cut
steps.detail: Tap ROCKER DOWN again to skip the section between the marks.

steps.label: Undo the cut
steps.detail: Tap ROCKER UP to put the section back.

steps.label: Mark a cut on Track 1
steps.detail: With the rocker page still open, hold T1 and tap ROCKER DOWN.

steps.label: Cut only Track 1
steps.detail: Keep holding T1 and tap ROCKER DOWN again. The other tracks keep their full length.

steps.label: Restore the tape
steps.detail: Hold FN and double-tap PLAY to clear the remaining cut.

cards.title: Record from Bluetooth
cards.gesture: Tap FN twice, then hold the third press
cards.body: Tap FN twice, then hold FN on the third press for about one second to enable Bluetooth audio discovery. Pair SP-1 from your phone or computer, select it as the audio output, then record normally.
cards.note: The gesture also works during playback and USB audio. USB and Bluetooth input mix together. This release focuses on Bluetooth input; outgoing audio to speakers or keyboards is deferred.

steps.label: Enable Bluetooth audio
steps.detail: Tap FN twice, then hold its third press for about one second.

steps.label: Pair from your audio source
steps.detail: All four track lights fade together while pairing. Choose SP-1 in Bluetooth settings. The lights sweep once when connected.

steps.label: Record the sound
steps.detail: Tap empty Track 3 and start Bluetooth audio. Its light turns solid when recording starts.

steps.label: Finish the take
steps.detail: Tap Track 3 again to finish. The take joins the loop.

cards.title: Choose a rocker mode
cards.gesture: FN + both VOL · VOL− / VOL+ to choose
cards.body: Hold FN and both volume buttons to open the rocker page. Release FN, then use VOL− / VOL+ to select a mode. Tap FN to close; the selected mode stays active.
cards.note: 1 Pitch · 2 Wind · 3 Bender · 4 Battery · 5 Sandpaper · 6 Magnet · 7 Scissors / glue · 8 Manual tape head. Keep the rocker page open for per-track Magnet or Scissors gestures. Holding TRACK previews the normal track lights.

steps.label: Open the rocker page
steps.detail: Hold FN + VOL− + VOL+.

steps.label: Choose a mode
steps.detail: Release FN. VOL+ moves forward; VOL− moves back.

steps.label: Return to tracks
steps.detail: Tap FN. The selected rocker mode stays active.

cards.title: Wind
cards.gesture: Slot 2 · hold ROCKER UP / ROCKER DOWN
cards.body: Hold ROCKER UP to fast-forward or ROCKER DOWN to rewind. Release to let the tape settle back.
cards.note: With the WIND page open, hold TRACK + ROCKER UP/DOWN: T1 0.5×, T2 1.5×, T3 3×, T4 4×. Release to return to playback speed. Double-tap TRACK to latch that winding speed for bare-rocker use, including after leaving the page.

steps.label: Hold ROCKER DOWN, then release
steps.detail: Hold ROCKER UP to fast-forward or ROCKER DOWN to rewind. Release to let the tape settle back.

steps.label: Release or restore
steps.detail: Release the rocker. For a complete rocker reset, hold FN and double-tap PLAY.

cards.title: Bender
cards.gesture: Slot 3 · hold ROCKER UP / ROCKER DOWN
cards.body: Hold ROCKER DOWN to drag and stretch the tape. Hold ROCKER UP for repeated pulling surges. Release either direction for a spring-like recovery.
cards.note: Longer ROCKER DOWN holds stretch further. This changes playback; it does not rewrite your recordings.

steps.label: Hold ROCKER DOWN, then release
steps.detail: Hold ROCKER DOWN to drag and stretch the tape. Hold ROCKER UP for repeated pulling surges. Release either direction for a spring-like recovery.

steps.label: Release or restore
steps.detail: Release the rocker. For a complete rocker reset, hold FN and double-tap PLAY.

cards.title: Battery
cards.gesture: Slot 4 · hold ROCKER DOWN / ROCKER UP
cards.body: Hold ROCKER DOWN to increase battery-drain sag, wobble and stalls. Hold ROCKER UP to recover toward normal.
cards.note: The wear stays when you release. FN + double-tap PLAY restores the tape.

steps.label: Hold ROCKER DOWN, then release
steps.detail: Hold ROCKER DOWN to increase battery-drain sag, wobble and stalls. Hold ROCKER UP to recover toward normal.

steps.label: Release or restore
steps.detail: Release the rocker. For a complete rocker reset, hold FN and double-tap PLAY.

cards.title: Sandpaper
cards.gesture: Slot 5 · hold ROCKER DOWN / ROCKER UP
cards.body: Hold ROCKER DOWN to add roughness, breakup and tape drag. Hold ROCKER UP to reduce the wear.
cards.note: The wear stays when you release. FN + double-tap PLAY restores the tape.

steps.label: Hold ROCKER DOWN, then release
steps.detail: Hold ROCKER DOWN to add roughness, breakup and tape drag. Hold ROCKER UP to reduce the wear.

steps.label: Release or restore
steps.detail: Release the rocker. For a complete rocker reset, hold FN and double-tap PLAY.

cards.title: Magnet
cards.gesture: Slot 6 · hold ROCKER DOWN to erase · ROCKER UP to undo
cards.body: Hold ROCKER DOWN while playing to silence and mark the section passing under the head. Release to leave a gap without shortening the loop. Tap ROCKER UP to undo. With the rocker page open, hold TRACK to target only that track.
cards.note: Unlike Scissors, Magnet keeps the loop’s length. FN + double-tap PLAY restores all Magnet gaps. Song changes and new recordings can clear the affected temporary gaps.

steps.label: Hold ROCKER DOWN, then release
steps.detail: Hold ROCKER DOWN while playing to silence and mark the section passing under the head. Release to leave a gap without shortening the loop. Tap ROCKER UP to undo. With the rocker page open, hold TRACK to target only that track.

steps.label: Release or restore
steps.detail: Release the rocker. For a complete rocker reset, hold FN and double-tap PLAY.

cards.title: Manual tape head
cards.gesture: Slot 8 · hold ROCKER DOWN + move faders
cards.body: Hold ROCKER UP to make contact with the running tape. Hold ROCKER DOWN for four-head contact; move F1–F4 to position the heads. Release to lift contact and silence the tape.
cards.note: The transport keeps moving while contact is lifted. Leave this rocker mode to return to ordinary playback. This is separate from latching Heads with FN + triple-tap PLAY.

steps.label: Hold ROCKER UP for tape contact
steps.detail: The transport keeps moving. Hold ROCKER UP to hear the tape.

steps.label: Hold ROCKER DOWN for four heads
steps.detail: Keep ROCKER DOWN held and move F1–F4 to position the four heads.

steps.label: Release to lift contact
steps.detail: The tape becomes silent while transport keeps moving.

steps.label: Leave Manual tape head
steps.detail: With the rocker page open, use VOL− to choose another slot and return to ordinary playback.

cards.title: Restore the tape
cards.body: Restore normal rocker tape behavior: clear Scissors cuts and Magnet changes, release wind and reset speed.
cards.note: The four TRACK lights briefly turn solid. Recordings and effect-page settings stay intact.

steps.label: Hold FN
steps.detail: Keep FN held.

steps.label: Double-tap PLAY
steps.detail: Restore the tape. Release the controls.

cards.title: Trim a track’s length
cards.gesture: Hold FN + PLAY · move that track’s fader
cards.body: Hold FN and PLAY, then move F1–F4 to shorten or lengthen the matching track. Lower the fader to shorten; raise it to lengthen. Release both to keep the trim.
cards.note: The first small move catches the current length without jumping. With a grid, lengths step through straight and dotted musical values. Other tracks keep playing; the original recording stays intact.

steps.label: Hold FN + PLAY
steps.detail: Keep both buttons held. Each fader targets its own track.

steps.label: Shorten Track 1
steps.detail: Keep FN + PLAY held and lower F1. Only Track 1 loops over a shorter piece.

steps.label: Keep the trim
steps.detail: Release both buttons. The shorter loop stays; faders return to level control with pickup.

cards.title: Slide the kept section
cards.gesture: Hold PLAY · move the trimmed track’s fader
cards.body: After trimming a track, hold PLAY and move its fader to slide the kept section through the recording. Its length stays the same. Raise the fader toward the start; lower it toward the end.
cards.note: The first small move catches the current position. With a grid, movement follows sixteenth-note steps. Release PLAY to keep the position; moving the fader spends the PLAY press, so it does not pause or restart playback.

steps.label: Start with a trimmed track
steps.detail: Track 1 already has a shorter kept section; Track 2 continues normally.

steps.label: Hold PLAY and slide
steps.detail: Hold PLAY, then lower F1 to move the kept section later in Track 1.

steps.label: Keep its position
steps.detail: Release PLAY. The section keeps its length and new position.

rockerModes.name: Pitch
rockerModes.summary: Change the whole tape’s speed and pitch.
rockerModes.up: Click to increase speed. Double-click for the next semitone; hold to keep stepping.
rockerModes.down: Click to decrease speed. Double-click for the previous semitone; hold to keep stepping.
rockerModes.reset: FN + double-tap PLAY returns to normal speed.
rockerModes.tip: The normal range is 0.25×–2×. FN + PLAY + rocker makes octave jumps.

rockerModes.name: Wind
rockerModes.summary: Fast-forward or rewind through the tape.
rockerModes.release: Speed settles back and the previous playback directions return.
rockerModes.reset: Release the rocker. FN + double-tap PLAY restores the tape.
rockerModes.tip: Page open: hold T1/T2/T3/T4 + rocker for 0.5×/1.5×/3×/4×. Double-tap TRACK to latch its speed for bare-rocker winding, also after closing the page. Release rocker returns to playback speed.

rockerModes.name: Bender
rockerModes.summary: Drag the tape or pull it in uneven surges.
rockerModes.down: Hold to drag and stretch the tape; longer holds stretch further.
rockerModes.release: The tape springs back toward the set speed.
rockerModes.reset: Release the rocker, or FN + double-tap PLAY to restore the tape.
rockerModes.tip: Unlike Pitch, a bend is temporary. Your recordings stay unchanged.

rockerModes.name: Battery
rockerModes.summary: Make the motor sag, wobble and stall.
rockerModes.reset: Hold ROCKER UP to recover gradually. FN + double-tap PLAY restores the tape.
rockerModes.tip: Release leaves the tired-battery sound in place so you can keep performing.

rockerModes.name: Sandpaper
rockerModes.summary: Roughen the tape with breakup and drag.
rockerModes.down: Hold to add roughness and breakup.
rockerModes.reset: Hold ROCKER UP to clean it up gradually. FN + double-tap PLAY restores the tape.
rockerModes.tip: Battery changes the motor’s behavior; Sandpaper adds a rougher, damaged-tape texture.

rockerModes.name: Magnet
rockerModes.summary: Erase a passing section from playback without shortening the loop.
rockerModes.up: Tap to undo the latest matching erase.
rockerModes.down: Hold while the section passes, then release to leave a silent gap.
rockerModes.release: The gap stays; the rest of the loop keeps its timing.
rockerModes.target: Bare rocker targets loaded tracks. With the rocker page open, hold TRACK to target only that track.
rockerModes.reset: ROCKER UP undoes a recent erase. FN + double-tap PLAY clears all Magnet gaps.
rockerModes.tip: The original audio is unchanged. A Magnet gap keeps its place in time.

rockerModes.name: Scissors / glue
rockerModes.summary: Cut out a section and join the remaining tape.
rockerModes.up: Tap to cancel the first mark, or undo the last cut.
rockerModes.down: Tap at the start, then tap again at the end of the section.
rockerModes.release: Each completed cut stays, including after leaving the rocker page or slot.
rockerModes.target: Bare taps target loaded tracks. Keep the rocker page open and hold the same TRACK for both marks to cut only that track.
rockerModes.reset: ROCKER UP undoes; FN + double-tap PLAY restores all cuts.
rockerModes.tip: Up to eight cuts. Use a full forward loop with playback running, without trim, repeat, Heads or recording. Song/take changes, recording or reboot clear the cuts.

rockerModes.name: Manual tape head
rockerModes.summary: Touch the moving tape with one contact or four heads.
rockerModes.up: Hold to hear the tape under ordinary contact.
rockerModes.down: Hold for four-head contact. Move F1–F4 to position the heads.
rockerModes.release: Contact lifts and the tape becomes silent; transport keeps moving.
rockerModes.target: The active tape source; ROCKER DOWN exposes four playback heads.
rockerModes.reset: Leave this slot to return to ordinary playback.
rockerModes.tip: PLAY starts or stops the tape. This contact mode is separate from latching Heads with FN + triple-tap PLAY.
